notes.title: [Add to your wishlist!] Rocket of Whispers: Prologue will be released for free soon
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31699457/06f14b5543b5633b1c9cee4d029d6a7fe6b1168b.png[/img]

[h1] ❄️add it onto your wishlist❄️: [/h1] https://store.steampowered.com/app/910460/Rocket_of_Whispers_Prologue/ 
As thanks to all supporters of OPUS: Rocket of Whispers up until now, we have decided to release Rocket of Whispers: Prologue for [b]*free*[/b] . This short companion piece lasts around 15 minutes, and supports English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese.
.
The cryonic sleeping pod has been disabled, and the witch who has slept for over a decade must finally awaken…

Go back to the very beginning of OPUS: Rocket of Whispers - before Fei met John. In this game, you must help Fei find a way out of the cellar, while discovering memories hidden from her under the apocalyptic snow.
.
[Release date] September 12 (Wednesday) for *free*

The latest trailer is out! Check it out on the Steam page, and ❄️[b]add it onto your wishlist[/b] ❄️ so you instantly know when it’s out: https://store.steampowered.com/app/910460/Rocket_of_Whispers_Prologue/ 

We sincerely hope that all players will be able to explore a never-before-seen side to OPUS: Rocket of Whispers.

.

為了感謝大家陪著《OPUS 靈魂之橋》走過從開發到的九百多個日子，我們決定免費釋出前傳作品——《靈魂之橋前傳：追憶》，這是款遊玩時間約 15 分鐘的非商業極短篇遊戲，將支援繁中、英文及日文。

冷凍艙運作解除，沈眠五十年的女巫終於甦醒⋯⋯
這次，你將重返靈魂之橋故事起源、回到芳與約翰相遇之前，
揭開被末日時光埋藏的，那份屬於她的記憶。

最新預告片釋出！現在就到遊戲頁面觀看，並把它❄️[b]加進你的 wishlist[/b]❄️，接收上架第一手消息：https://store.steampowered.com/app/910460/Rocket_of_Whispers_Prologue/
